label: Monthly revenue by subscription tier (last 12 months). Subscription invoices: (Invoice)-[:FOR_SUBSCRIPTION]->(Subscription)-[:ON_TIER]->(SubscriptionTier) traversal. Marketplace invoices: (User)-[:HAS_SUBSCRIPTION] lateral equivalent via ORDER BY started_at DESC + head(collect()). Temporal pricing join on 5 in-memory pricing rows.

Complete invoice fetch (customer + line items + product details). Single Cypher traversal: (User)-[:HAS_INVOICE]->(Invoice)-[:HAS_LINE]->(InvoiceLine) + OPTIONAL MATCH to Product. Random invoice sampled from pool of 1000 IDs.
Session + cart retrieval by user_id under 50 concurrent threads. Cart stored as JSON string property — requires json.loads(). Random user from pool of 1000 IDs.

Top 10 co-purchase recommendations via 2-hop Cypher traversal. No precomputed ALSO_BOUGHT edges — co-purchase counts aggregated at query time. Mirrors PostgreSQL 2-hop JOIN structure. Random product from pool of 1000 IDs.
Full-text product search via toLower() CONTAINS — sequential node scan, no full-text index. No relevance ranking available. Random term per iteration from pool of 25 queries.

All events for a user in a 30-day window ordered by occurred_at DESC. Naive: separate indexes on user_id and occurred_at — planner uses one, filters the other in memory. Pool of 1000 (user_id, anchor) pairs.

Daily revenue aggregated by tier over 183 days. Partial Q7 equivalent — Neo4j does not support generate_series (gap-filling) or window functions (rolling average). Benchmarks the Cypher aggregation only. No schema effect vs optimised — engine effect only.

Monthly revenue by subscription tier (last 12 months). Cypher identical to naive — schema optimisations (full-text index, composite event index, ALSO_BOUGHT, native cart) do not affect Q1. Measures engine effect only vs naive. Temporal pricing join on 5 in-memory pricing rows.

Complete invoice fetch (customer + line items + product details). Cypher identical to naive — schema optimisations do not affect Q2. Measures engine effect only. Random invoice sampled from pool of 1000 IDs.

Session + cart retrieval by user_id under 50 concurrent threads. Cart stored as native Neo4j list — no outer json.loads(). Schema effect vs naive: eliminates JSON string deserialisation. Random user from pool of 1000 IDs.

Top 10 co-purchase recommendations via single-hop ALSO_BOUGHT traversal. Edges precomputed at load time with count and confidence as relationship properties — zero aggregation at query time. Schema effect vs naive: eliminates full 2-hop traversal. Random product from pool of 1000 IDs.

Full-text product search via native full-text index ('product_search') with English analyser and BM25 scoring. Schema effect vs naive: sequential CONTAINS scan eliminated, relevance ranking enabled. Random term per iteration from pool of 25 queries.

All events for a user in a 30-day window ordered by occurred_at DESC. Optimised: composite index on (user_id, occurred_at) — both predicates pushed into single index scan. Schema effect vs naive: eliminates in-memory occurred_at filter. Pool of 1000 (user_id, anchor) pairs.

Daily revenue aggregated by tier over 183 days. Cypher identical to naive — schema optimisations do not affect Q7. Partial Q7 equivalent: gap-filling and rolling average not available in Neo4j. Benchmarks Cypher aggregation only.
